data.long_meaning: Ansnath is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'ansan', meaning 'pure'. In Hindu mythology, Ansnath is revered as the deity who bestows purity and cleanses the soul. The name embodies the spirit of inner and outer cleanliness and is a reminder to maintain a pure and virtuous life.
